[package]
  cjc-version = "1.1.0"
  name = "wirestack"
  organization = ""
  description = "Cross-platform TLS, HTTPS, HTTP/1.1 and HTTP/2 stack for Cangjie"
  version = "0.1.0"
  target-dir = ""
  script-dir = ""
  src-dir = "src"
  output-type = "static"
  compile-option = ""
  override-compile-option = ""
  link-option = ""
  package-configuration = {}
  repository = "https://github.com/lIlIIlIll/Wirestack.git"
  homepage = "https://github.com/lIlIIlIll/Wirestack"
  documentation = "https://github.com/lIlIIlIll/Wirestack/tree/main/docs"

[target.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu]
  link-option = "-lstdc++ -lpthread -ldl -lm"

[target.x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.ffi.c]
  wirestack_resolver = { path = "./target/native/resolver/current/lib" }
  wirestack_tls_provider = { path = "./target/native/current/lib" }
  wirestack_http_files = { path = "./target/native/http_files/current/lib" }

[target.x86_64-w64-mingw32]
  link-option = "-lws2_32"

[target.x86_64-w64-mingw32.ffi.c]
  wirestack_resolver = { path = "./target/native/resolver/current/lib" }

[target.aarch64-apple-darwin]
  link-option = ""

[target.aarch64-apple-darwin.ffi.c]
  wirestack_resolver = { path = "./target/native/resolver/macos-arm64/current/lib" }

[target.arm64-apple-ios11-simulator]
  override-compile-option = "--sysroot ./target/native/resolver/ios-simulator-arm64/sdk"
  link-option = ""

[target.arm64-apple-ios11-simulator.ffi.c]
  wirestack_resolver = { path = "./target/native/resolver/ios-simulator-arm64/current/lib" }
